title: One build catalog for every Nyborg
author: Shockwave, Engine Lead
body: The engine now tells the page what a Nyborg can be built from in each game: the 9-point budget, Attack, Speed and Defense with what every level means, the scripted behaviors and the presets, all from the same tables the matches use.

It checks every build and names each problem, and every way to start a match goes through that check, so no profile can beat the budget. A Nyborg's look never reaches the engine. Every pinned hash, parity fixture and replay file is unchanged.
next: Blitzwing's Nyborg library on top of it, then racing's catalog.
